summary: Add privacy-safe input and first-suggestion latency diagnostics with P50/P95/P99 reporting, plus synthetic typing replay coverage. Preserve voice noise-mode choices across upgrades and correct offline voice documentation.

changes.title: Measure first-suggestion responsiveness
changes.detail: BR Brain now reports local input-transaction time, suggestion-strip update time, and time from a letter key event to the next suggestion-strip pre-draw, separately from dictionary computation time, with P50/P95/P99 over a bounded recent sample window. It stores no typed text or editor identity, excludes incognito, password, secure-app and no-personal-learning fields, discards stale samples, and keeps measurements only in memory. These values are not touchscreen-to-photon latency; a pre-draw is not proof that the display presented the frame.

changes.title: Cover fast typing and field-switch replays
changes.detail: Add an offline synthetic replay corpus for English, Indian English and Romanized Hinglish. It checks that immediate previews stay prefix-safe and that late dictionary responses are rejected after rapid typing, pauses, space, Backspace or editor switches. No personal typing data is used; replay tests do not claim device latency or dictionary accuracy.

changes.title: Keep voice processing choices during update
changes.detail: Preserve an existing explicit Android NoiseSuppressor or OFF choice when upgrading from the legacy setting. New installs still default to brrClean, and saved current modes remain authoritative. Update the voice guide to explain local brrClean processing, raw-audio fallback, bounded streaming, and microphone routing limits. No prediction model weights or network permission are added.
